description: Request one exact represented-human message, optionally with one image attachment. Text-only behavior remains approval-gated as before. For an attachment, first call with attachment descriptor {name,content_type,size_bytes,sha256} and NO bytes; the exact human approves that descriptor/hash in Customer Hub. After approval, call again with the same thread/body/idempotency_key/attachment plus attachment_content_base64. Bytes must exactly match size/SHA and are accepted only through the one-shot approved delegation. Agent/MCP attachment transport is limited to 2 MiB and JPEG/PNG/WebP. thread_token is POST-body-only.

attachment_content_base64.description: Second phase only, after represented-human approval; must match the approved attachment size and SHA-256 exactly.

name: conversation_send
